# Paddltir — product copy for LLMs

> Dragon boat crew management software. Configure rosters, build race-day
> crewlists, seat standard boats, and get trim and balance insights before
> every heat. Web app: https://app.paddltir.com

Canonical site: https://paddltir.com · Short index: https://paddltir.com/llms.txt

## What Paddltir is

Paddltir helps dragon boat clubs manage crews on race day. Keep paddler
details — name, weight, preferred side — in one roster. Build separate
crewlists per heat so open, mixed, and women's lineups don't overwrite each
other. Seat a standard boat (twenty paddlers, drummer, sweep) and see side
balance and fore-aft trim update as you swap people.

Built for coaches, sweeps, and club organisers who currently juggle
clipboards, shared spreadsheets, and last-minute texts on the pontoon.

## Core features

- **Rosters** — paddlers, sides, weights, and availability in one place
- **Crewlists** — heat-by-heat lineups for race day; separate lists per category
- **Boat seating** — drag paddlers into seats left and right; assign drummer and sweep
- **Trim and balance** — fore-aft trim, side weight, and empty-seat checks before launch
- **Copy between heats** — start from a seated boat and adjust for the next race

## Open the app

1. Open https://app.paddltir.com in your browser
2. Sign in with email or Google — your account is created on first visit
3. Add paddlers to a roster, create a crewlist, seat your first boat

Works on desktop and mobile browsers. Feature reference: https://paddltir.com/docs

## FAQ

**What is Paddltir?**
Dragon boat crew management: build lineups, keep rosters and crewlists
organised, and check trim and balance before you race.

**Who is it for?**
Coaches, sweeps, and club organisers — especially clubs running multiple
heats in a day.

**What's the difference between a roster and a crewlist?**
A roster is your pool of paddlers. A crewlist is the set available for a
specific race or training block. You seat boats from a crewlist.

**Can I run multiple heats?**
Yes. Configure separate lineups per heat so open, mixed, and women's crews
don't overwrite each other.

**How does weight affect seating?**
Heavier paddlers shift the boat's centre of mass. Paddltir shows trim so you
can move people forward or aft before you race.

**Is my crew data private?**
Your account, paddlers, and crewlists belong to you. See the privacy page for
what we store.

Full FAQ: https://paddltir.com/faq

## About (https://paddltir.com/about)

Paddltir is an independent dragon boat crew management project built by Jun
Lee. Rosters, crewlists, boat configs, and trim insights in one place.

## Compare (https://paddltir.com/compare)

Three ways to build a race-day lineup: paper roster, shared spreadsheet, or
Paddltir. Paper is fast to start but hard to rebalance. Spreadsheets drift
with conflicting edits. Paddltir keeps one roster, seats boats with live
trim checks, and scopes changes to the heat you're working on.
